bead.title: Step 0 — Model census + selection-fallback hierarchy
bead.description: Produce docs/research/model-census-2026-04-XX.md with one row per candidate (model, provider, release/refresh date, output $/Mtok, input $/Mtok, cached-input $/Mtok if applicable, max output tokens, tool-use quality, harness compatibility for codex/claude-code/opencode/pi/ddx-agent, model-snapshot-id). Apply the v7 selection-fallback hierarchy in order: (1) tool-use viable; (2) in bracket (output <= $3/Mtok); (3) recency (>=2025-11-01). Exclusions documented for audit trail. Pick Phase A.1 anchor + Phase A.2 second model from surviving rows; vendors must differ across A.1 anchor and A.2 second. Excluded by recency: GPT-4o, GPT-4.1-mini, original Sonnet/Haiku/Gemini-2.5-Flash. Excluded by bracket: Sonnet 4.6, Opus, GPT-5 full.
bead.acceptance: Doc lands; selection-fallback hierarchy applied per row with outcomes; user signs off on (anchor, second-model) pair. If no kept candidate exists for a vendor, that vendor is dropped from Phase A — not substituted with non-compliant fallback.
